name: Animation Compiler
description: Compiles Knowledge Objects into animated videos

pipeline.name: validate-input
pipeline.action: Validate KO has required fields: id, title, concepts, examples

pipeline.name: generate-lesson
pipeline.description: Generate lesson structure from Knowledge Object
pipeline.action: Transform KO into lesson with sections, timing, and learning objectives

pipeline.name: generate-visual-spec
pipeline.action: Define colors, typography, layouts, and visual style for each section

pipeline.name: generate-scene-graph
pipeline.description: Generate scene graph from visual spec
pipeline.action: Create tree of scenes, sequences, and components with timing

pipeline.name: select-components
pipeline.action: Map scene requirements to existing components in registry

pipeline.name: generate-timeline
pipeline.action: Create frame-accurate timeline with sequences and transitions

pipeline.name: compose-components
pipeline.action: Generate React/Remotion components from timeline and component list

pipeline.name: validate-preview
pipeline.action: Check timing, visual consistency, accessibility, performance

pipeline.name: validate-output
pipeline.action: Check video quality, file size, duration, accessibility
